summary: kepler@2.1.999 resolves install-scripted dependency from non-registry host
details: kepler@2.1.999 is published to public npm with placeholder metadata and a dependency-confusion-shaped version number. Its lockfile pins the dependency 'flag-serial-object-syntax' to a direct URL at https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/flag-serial-object-syntax rather than the npm registry, and marks that dependency with hasInstallScript:true. On `npm install kepler`, npm fetches the tarball from artifacts.yosiroute.com and runs its lifecycle install script on the installer's host, handing install-time code execution to whoever controls yosiroute.com. The kepler package itself carries no library payload of note; its function is to pull in the externally hosted, install-scripted dependency.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
